what_it_is: Year-over-year % increase in revenue for each forecast year.
why_this_choice: Y1 ≈ company FY2026 revenue guidance (~$2.53B / FY25 $1.991B − 1 ≈ 27%). Then fade toward terminal g=3% (not straight-lined). This is the main forward-looking judgment; it drives Rev → GP → EBT → Net Earnings → CF.
source: SEC EX-99.1 Q3 FY2026 — updated FY2026 revenue guidance $2.53B

what_it_is: Cost of revenues as a % of sales (gross margin = 1 − this).
how_set_in_model: Excel equation: I25/I24 (FY25 COGS ÷ FY25 Revenue) held flat.
why_this_choice: Locks in latest reported cost structure (~17.8%). Scores mix is high-margin; holding FY25 is conservative vs further mix shift.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Cost of revenues / Total revenues

how_set_in_model: Equation: MAX(15%, (I28 − 10,922)/I24 − 75bps × year). Strips FY25 restructuring; then −0.75% of sales each year.
why_this_choice: MODEL9: restore software operating leverage. Floor 15%; grind −75 bps/yr so SG&A can scale toward mid-teens as revenue expands (not stuck ~24–25%).

what_it_is: Research & development expense as % of sales (IS label: R&D, not Rent).
why_this_choice: FICO reinvests steadily in analytics/software. Flat % grows dollars with revenue.

what_it_is: Depreciation rate from FY25; dollars = (Opening PPE + CapEx/2) × DA%.
how_set_in_model: Rate = I30/I44 (FY25 DA ÷ FY25 PPE). Forecast DA$ = (Open + CapEx/2) × rate.
why_this_choice: MODEL9: Depreciation uses (Opening PPE + CapEx/2) × DA%, the non-circular form of average net PP&E depreciation (equivalent to mid-year CapEx convention). Half of current CapEx is treated as in service for the year (mid-year convention) without a circular closing-PPE loop.

what_it_is: Interest expense as % of opening debt balance.
how_set_in_model: Excel equation: I101/I98 (FY25 interest ÷ FY25 opening debt in schedule).
why_this_choice: Approximates average coupon / cost of debt on the book. Debt held flat (issuance = 0), so interest stays linked to that stock.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Interest expense; see also 8-K 6.250% notes

what_it_is: Effective book tax rate applied to forecast EBT.
how_set_in_model: Excel equation: I35/I33 (FY25 tax ÷ simplified FY25 EBT in this template).
why_this_choice: Uses reported effective rate (~19% on template EBT; ~18.8% on 10-K EBT). UFCF in DCF also uses unlevered EBIT × t.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Provision for income taxes / Income before taxes

what_it_is: Days Sales Outstanding. AR = Revenue × DSO / 365.
how_set_in_model: Excel equation: ROUND(I42/I24×365, 0) from FY25; held flat each forecast year.
why_this_choice: MODEL9: Working Capital forecasting has been transitioned from a top-down NWC % of sales methodology to a bottom-up approach using DSO and DPO historical drivers to eliminate artificial cash flow distortions. Row 15 is DSO again (not NWC%). AR is organic from collections days — no top-down NWC% AR plug.

how_set_in_model: Hard zero — FICO is software / scores; inventory is immaterial.

what_it_is: Days Payable Outstanding. AP = COGS × DPO / 365.
how_set_in_model: Excel equation: ROUND(I48/I25×365, 0) from FY25; held flat.
why_this_choice: MODEL9: DPO is an explicit WC driver paired with DSO. NWC = AR + Inventory − AP − Deferred (output); ΔNWC = NWCt − NWCt−1.

what_it_is: Capital investment (PPE + capitalized software) as % of sales.
how_set_in_model: Equation: fade from I68/I24 toward 1.0% steady. MODEL9 weights 40%→20%→10%→0%→0% on the peak (fast fade).
why_this_choice: Prior path left CapEx ≫ D&A (~$80M cumulative drag). Fade to maintenance ~1% so CapEx ≈ D&A by Y5 (terminal cash conversion).
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — PP&E purchases + capitalized software

what_it_is: New borrowing (+) or repayment (−) in the forecast.
why_this_choice: Hold debt stock flat at FY25 level for the explicit period; interest follows. Net debt for DCF equity bridge uses the later 10-Q amount separately.
source: SEC 10-Q Q3 FY2026 — debt stock (financing excluded from FCFF)

what_it_is: New equity issued (+) or buybacks (−) in the forecast BS/CF.
why_this_choice: Buybacks are real historically but are financing — excluded from FCFF. Share count for $/share is the spot shares outstanding assumption.
source: Damodaran FCFF framework — financing (buybacks) not in FCFF

what_it_is: Effective tax rate used for FCFF NOPAT and after-tax cost of debt.
how_set_in_model: Linked live to 3-Statement!J13 (= FY25 tax / simplified EBT).
why_this_choice: DCF must use the same t as the 3-statement forecast.

what_it_is: Weighted average cost of capital for XNPV of FCFF + TV.
why_this_choice: Market-consistent discount rate from Rf, β, ERP, and note coupon.
source: FRED DGS10 / Damodaran ERP / Yahoo β / 8-K 6.250% notes

what_it_is: Long-run growth used only in the Gordon TV cross-check.
why_this_choice: Long-run nominal GDP-like floor; primary TV uses exit multiple.

what_it_is: Terminal enterprise value multiple on Year-5 EBITDA.
how_set_in_model: POLICY BASE 17.5x; Bull 25.0x; Bear 12.8x. Peer set: EFX 13.88x, VRSK 17.42x, SPGI 18.11x, MCO 22.20x, MSCI 23.74x. Median ≈ 18.11x.
why_this_choice: Base 17.5x is near the public peer median (18.1x), between Gordon-implied bear and spot/bull.
source: VCP Scanner FICO peer EV/EBITDA comps

what_it_is: Gross debt and cash+marketable securities for EV → equity.
how_set_in_model: 10-Q Q3 FY2026 totals (more current than FY25 3S balances).
why_this_choice: Bridge should reflect the latest capital structure; 3S FY25 shown as reference.
